text: How does a bank name a card's scheme and issuer from its first digits, and keep the number itself out of every other system?
prefix: How does a bank name a card's scheme and issuer from its first digits, and keep the number itself out of every other system?

text: A card's first digits, its BIN, name the scheme and the issuing bank.
prefix: A card's first digits, its BIN, name the scheme and the issuing bank.

text: Both schemes publish their BIN lists, so the BIN module in card-vault syncs them through the adapters into its own schema, at startup and every night.
prefix: Both schemes publish their BIN lists, so the BIN module in card-vault syncs them through the adapters into its own schema, at startup and every night.

text: The sync is idempotent, and a scheme that doesn't answer, or answers with nothing, keeps its old list.
prefix: The sync is idempotent, and a scheme that doesn't answer, or answers with nothing, keeps its old list.

text: A range the schemes' lists don't carry yet can be added by hand, and no sync removes it.
prefix: A range the schemes' lists don't carry yet can be added by hand, and no sync removes it.

text: Lookups never touch the database: an in-memory index cuts a card's first digits from the longest known BIN length down to the shortest, and the first match wins.
prefix: Lookups never touch the database: an in-memory index cuts a card's first digits from the longest known BIN length down to the shortest, and the first match wins.

text: A bank directory in the configuration names each issuer in English, Russian and Uzbek, and without it card-vault doesn't start.
prefix: A bank directory in the configuration names each issuer in English, Russian and Uzbek, and without it card-vault doesn't start.

text: Before any scheme is asked, the card module checks the Luhn digit, then asks the BIN module for the scheme, sending only the first eight digits.
prefix: Before any scheme is asked, the card module checks the Luhn digit, then asks the BIN module for the scheme, sending only the first eight digits.

text: A plain card number in a database would be a disaster on the day of a breach.
prefix: A plain card number in a database would be a disaster on the day of a breach.

text: So card numbers live in one place only: card-vault, in the cards unit.
prefix: So card numbers live in one place only: card-vault, in the cards unit.

text: Other units hold a card token instead and call card-vault over mutual T L S, where each operation needs its own role: bind, read, debit, reports or admin.
prefix: Other units hold a card token instead and call card-vault over mutual T L S, where each operation needs its own role: bind, read, debit, reports or admin.

text: Card data is sealed by Vault Transit: card-vault sends a value in and keeps only the ciphertext, so the keys never leave Vault.
prefix: Card data is sealed by Vault Transit: card-vault sends a value in and keeps only the ciphertext, so the keys never leave Vault.

text: Each value is sealed with a context naming its column and its card, so a ciphertext copied to another row doesn't open.
prefix: Each value is sealed with a context naming its column and its card, so a ciphertext copied to another row doesn't open.

text: Rotation is Vault's own: new values take the new key version, older ones still open, and a rewrap moves them forward.
prefix: Rotation is Vault's own: new values take the new key version, older ones still open, and a rewrap moves them forward.

text: To find a card without decrypting anything, the vault keeps a blind index, a Transit HMAC of the number, pinned to one key version so the same number always gives the same index.
prefix: To find a card without decrypting anything, the vault keeps a blind index, a Transit HMAC of the number, pinned to one key version so the same number always gives the same index.

text: When Vault is down or refuses, card-vault fails closed with card processor unavailable, and never guesses.
prefix: When Vault is down or refuses, card-vault fails closed with card processor unavailable, and never guesses.

text: The database itself refuses any card value that isn't a Vault ciphertext.
prefix: The database itself refuses any card value that isn't a Vault ciphertext.

text: A number is decrypted only to hand it to the card's scheme, and every use of card data is written to an audit trail.
prefix: A number is decrypted only to hand it to the card's scheme, and every use of card data is written to an audit trail.

text: Bank admins reach cards and the BIN directory only through the API, with the cards admin role, and a search by number answers only the masked number.
prefix: Bank admins reach cards and the BIN directory only through the API, with the cards admin role, and a search by number answers only the masked number.

text: Next, the payment itself, starting with a request nobody can forge.
prefix: Next, the payment itself, starting with a request nobody can forge.
